name: Bless
description: Restores one person fully and doubles how fast they learn for a few days.

name: Inspire
description: A dream that makes one person far likelier to discover something new for a while.

name: Omen
description: A sign in the sky that sets what the whole tribe focuses on for a while.

name: Portal
description: Choose a party of up to five and a floor, and call them through the portal. Free, but the dungeon is deadly.

name: Smite
description: Strike someone with lightning. The wicked deserve it; strike the innocent and your people will learn to fear you.

name: Storm
description: A storm of wind and lightning: crops and trees in its path are flattened and those caught in it are hurt.

name: Pestilence
description: A sickness falls on someone and those near them. A remedy cures it; an Infirmary slows it.

name: Gift
description: Grant someone a talent (three levels in a skill) or a piece of knowledge, even one the tribe has lost.

name: Eternal youth
description: The chosen never grow old and never die of age. They can still fall in battle.

name: Puppet
description: Bend the ruler to your will. Through them you can then issue decrees: marriages, the heir, buildings and the people's calling.

name: Expand
description: Raise the walls anew when the sanctuary is ready: more land, plots and new kinds of buildings.
